same_build_reference.scope: same executable, libraries, interface, period and case input; exact printed values

historical_comparison_scope: diagnostic across builds; no physical-error tolerance inferred

routing_contract.provenance: Single interposer signal layer using the existing assumed 10 um wire. Spacing and edge clearance are synthetic geometric rules, not foundry-qualified. Under-die routing is allowed; no vias, bumps, pad-escape geometry, crosstalk or PDK DRC.

timing_requirement.provenance: unchanged v0.5 demonstration assumption, not sourced protocol requirement

physical_model_error: unbounded; geometry and numerical convergence are not physical validation
receipt_scope: Compact projection of corrected local run. Raw reports stay under ignored results/. Dirty source identified by exact hashes. First failed CI retained separately.
